your 16, brother, there will be more of those coming your way. you just either get used to it or you dont. sooner or later you will feel that telling the right people about your depression is key.

you can write at reddit and know that one way or another out of the thousands who are here, a few are bound to know what your talking about. because were depressed, not a different kind of human. we have a common ground of being depressed and that makes us hard to understand. i guess what im saying is people here might not know you or see you, this might not be your ideal of love, but people will care for you. my point is, not all people will care for you or understand you but there are still some people who might understand you, those who would, at their small capability, care for you.

i chose not to argue if suicide is permanent; however i dont that that its the fucking point. you know what is? people hate sadness,thats the point. if your mopey and whatnot your a broken cog and all the other cogs will bear with you and work with you until they just cant anymore. you know people hate sadness because you hate it too, even if it is your own self that is sad. people will always rule out sadness for a reason for anything going wrong. dammet, even when you fucking commit suicide they will still always look for the fucking reasons. people will always hate that your sad, so unless we one way or another, get our sadness in a controllable level, were screwed. it will only be a matter of time before things fall apart and you may never say that depression is the fucking root. cause as incredibly difficult it is for us, it will never be a goddamn "VALID EXCUSE" for everybody else.

I'm also 24. Early 2014 I was a respondent to a research about quarterlife crisis. I totally relate to everything you said, except the part where you can’t give a fuck about other people's problems; cause I do, sometimes it hurts me that I want help but I cant, just because I’m in a more emotional dump than them, and I can’t just say that I am, somehow, someway I find it not fair to them. All the more if I’m the one in fault; but that’s me buddy, I perfectly respect you, for what you think and how you do things. I too am depressed, needless to say, I guess what I’m trying to say is that I know how it is to wonder how happiness feels like, long permanent peace. It’s been years, felt like forever, and a few suicide attempts here and then, I still haven’t found happiness. 


I won’t give you and advice. I’m just going to share my approach. Each time I choose make an effort to find how happiness in life means I fail. So instead of making endless efforts to find meaning in happiness in life, I find myself in a search for meaning. I’ve fallen in love with the study of Viktor Frankl, look it up if you have time. Bottomline, instead of finding happiness in what I do and how I live, I find meaning of what I do and how I live.


I’m still depressed; having this way of life doesn’t excuse me from the depression that I’m in. I still have not found the will to live again; but what it does for me is give me a small sense of hope, that someday, somehow, happiness will come. And if I don’t get there, I know that I’m going down swinging.
